The street is a warzone. <br><br> A tide of human panic surges down the avenue. You don't even get a chance to pick a direction before the crowd hits you. You are shoved violently, your boots sliding on asphalt slick with things you don't want to look at. <!-- IMAGE 1: THE MOB --> <div style="margin-bottom: 15px; text-align: center;"> <img src="image/Act2Street/themob.gif" style="max-width: 100%; border: 1px solid #333; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);"> </div> <<run window.shakeScreen(20)>> /* --- COMPANION CHECK: VANE --- */ <<if $vane_status == "joined">> <span style="color:var(--accent-blue);">Vane</span> grabs the strap of your bag, pulling hard. He's bleeding from a scrape on his cheek, but his dark eyes are wide and sharply focused. He gasps, looking back at the stampede. <br> <<chat "Vane" "image/avatars/vane.gif" "right" "This whole city is a death trap. We can't stay here. We have to get out. Anywhere but here.">> <<else>> You fight against the current, throwing your weight sideways until you tear yourself out of the crush, stumbling into a narrow, shadowed alleyway. You lean against a brick wall, your lungs burning. <br><br> The apartment building was a tomb, but the city is a slaughterhouse. You need to leave. Tonight. <</if>> <br><br> /* =================================================================== SCENE 2: THE ALLEYWAY (TRANSITION) =================================================================== */ <div class="choice-menu" id="street-choices"> <<button "Catch your breath">> <<completeObjective "survive_streets">> <<addObjective "explore_alley" "Find a way out of the alleyway">> /* --- AUDIO TRANSITION --- */ /* Crossfade from the open street to the muffled alleyway */ <<run setup.sound.crossfade("city_riot", "alley_riot", "audio/bgm/alley_muffled_riot.mp3", 2000, 0.6)>> /* --- PLAY THE JUMPSCARE SOUNDS --- */ <<run setup.sound.play("screech", "audio/sfx/falling_screech_doppler.mp3", false, 0.8)>> <<run setTimeout(function() { setup.sound.play("crunch", "audio/sfx/meat_asphalt_crunch.mp3", false, 1.0); setup.sound.play("tearing", "audio/sfx/frenzied_tearing.mp3", true, 0.7); }, 800)>> /* --- REVEAL ALLEYWAY CONTENT --- */ <<replace "#dynamic-story">> <!-- WE WRAP THE ALLEYWAY IN A DIV SO WE CAN HIDE IT LATER --> <div id="alley-content"> <h2>THE ALLEYWAY</h2> You take one deep breath. You don't get a second. <br><br> A screech echoes from above. Before you can even look up, a heavy mass plummets from a fire escape three stories overhead. <!-- IMAGE 2: THE JUMPSCARE --> <div style="margin-bottom: 15px; text-align: center;"> <img src="image/Act2Street/alley_jumpscare.gif" style="max-width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--accent-red); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(138,28,28,0.4);"> </div> <<run window.shakeScreen(30)>> It hits the pavement with a wet, sickening <i>CRUNCH</i> of asphalt and bone, completely flattening a civilian who had been running blindly down the alley. <br><br> The thing that fell doesn't stay down. Blood sprays across the brick wall. <br><br> </div> /* ======================================================= SCENE 3: ALLEYWAY RESOLUTION (KILL OR FLEE) ======================================================= */ <!-- This empty div holds the result of the kill/run choice --> <div id="alley-resolution"></div> <div class="choice-menu" id="alley-choices"> /* --------------------------------------------------- OPTION A: KILL IT --------------------------------------------------- */ <<button "Kill it! Your weapon comes down hard, crushing the infected's skull before it can fully tear the man's throat out. It goes limp. The civilian underneath is gurgling, eyes rolling back. You turn and sprint in the opposite direction, cutting through a narrow chain-link gate to put a barrier between you and the feeding frenzy. <br><br> You burst through the gate, chest heaving, and find yourself in a wide, open space. <br><br> <<set $hum -= 5>> <!-- Humanity penalty for running --> <!-- NEW INTERMEDIATE BUTTON FOR PACING --> <div class="choice-menu"> <<button "Catch your breath and look around">> <<run $("#alley-resolution").hide()>> /* FADE OUT AUDIO & BRING IN PARKING LOT AMBIENCE */ <<run setup.sound.fade("alley_riot", 2000)>> <<run setup.sound.play("parking_ambience", "audio/bgm/parking_lot_wind.mp3", true, 0.5)>> <<run $("#parking-lot-sequence").fadeIn()>> <</button>> </div> <</replace>> <</button>> </div> /* ======================================================= SCENE 4: THE PARKING LOT (CAR ESCAPE) ======================================================= */ <!-- HIDDEN PARKING LOT SEQUENCE --> <div id="parking-lot-sequence" style="display:none;"> <hr class="solid"> <h2>THE PARKING LOT</h2> <!-- IMAGE 3: THE GETAWAY CAR --> <div style="margin-bottom: 15px; text-align: center;"> <img src="image/Act2Street/blue_sedan.gif" style="max-width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--accent-blue); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);"> </div> You are standing in a gated parking lot behind a mid-rise office building. In the middle of the apocalypse, it feels like absolute magic. <<if $vane_status == "joined">> <br><br> Vane stares at you, a slow, impressed smile spreading across his face. <br> <<chat "Vane" "image/avatars/vane.gif" "right" "Okay. "Misspent youth," he mutters, pulling out a cluster of wires. ATMOSPHERIC ARRIVAL TEXT --- */ <<if _arrivedLate>> The sedan's engine idles in a low, sputtering rattle as you coast down the hill. A pale, freezing mist rises off the wet asphalt, lit by a weak gray morning sun struggling to pierce the thick canopy of pines. You slept a few hours at the cabin, but the exhaustion still sits heavy in your joints. The air out here carries the smell of pine resin and dead leaves. Clean, compared to the smoke-choked city. But it is too quiet. The kind of quiet that means all the birds left. <<else>> You have been driving on fumes for hours—steering through freezing rain until it died into a thick, suffocating fog. The road is pitch black, headlights cutting weak cones through mist that swallows landmarks whole. The dead of night, the cold, hollow hours before dawn when even your own breathing feels like a violation of the silence. Your eyes burn. The fuel gauge needle is buried past the red line, kissing empty. <</if>> <br><br> You bring the car to a crawl at a skewed intersection. A rusted metal signpost hangs from a bent post overhead, bullet-pocked and tilted from what might have been a vehicle impact days ago: <div style="margin: 15px 0; padding: 10px 15px; border-left: 3px solid #555; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.9em; color: #aaa; letter-spacing: 1px;"> <i>WELCOME TO TIMBERLINE — POP. 4,200</i> </div> The outskirts. Less dense than the concrete maze you fled, but the virus doesn't care about zip codes. The ditches are littered with abandoned cars, doors left wide open to the cold as if their owners simply stepped out and never came back. /* --- 2. COMPANION DIALOGUE BRANCHES --- */ <<nobr>> <<if _hasVane and _hasMaya>> /* ----------------------------------------------------------------- THREE-WAY DIALOGUE: MC + VANE + MAYA ----------------------------------------------------------------- */ <br><br> Vane leans against the passenger window, face pale under the dashboard glow, cradling Marcus's old journal in both hands. Whatever we pick here, we're committing to it on foot if we're wrong.">> <br> <<chat "Maya" "image/avatars/maya.gif" "right" "And doing this on foot with Lily... it isn't an option. That's where people run when they panic. Panic makes a mess.">> <<elseif _hasVane and _hasDiane>> /* ----------------------------------------------------------------- THREE-WAY DIALOGUE: MC + VANE + DIANE ----------------------------------------------------------------- */ <br><br> Vane sits slightly forward, knuckles white on Marcus's journal. Beside him, Diane stares blankly at the signpost, her sons huddled under a heavy survival blanket in the back. The silence in the car carries the heavy, raw sting of the cabin. <br><br> <<chat "Vane" "image/avatars/vane.gif" "right" "We're running on nothing but vapors. If we don't find fuel or a place to hole up soon, we're going to be pushing this car.">> <br> <<chat "Diane" "image/avatars/diane.gif" "right" "Marcus used to say you could read a town like a face. Maya watches you in the rearview mirror. Her sons are asleep in the back under a coarse blanket, their breathing shallow and slow. She hasn't spoken since the cabin. The weight between you is the specific, unbearable weight of a death that didn't need to happen, and that both of you know it. <br><br> After a long silence, she speaks. Quietly. Not looking at you. <br><br> <<chat "Diane" "image/avatars/diane.gif" "right" "Marcus used to say you could read a town like a face. Her voice doesn't waver. <br><br> <<chat "Diane" "image/avatars/diane.gif" "right" "I need you to be right about this one. I can't—I can't lose them too.">> <br> <<chat "You" "image/avatars/player.gif" "left" "I'm going to be right about this one. I promise you.">> <br> <i style="color:#666; font-size:0.85em;">You aren't sure you believe it. But you say it the way you mean it, which is the only way a promise like that works.</i> <<else>> /* ----------------------------------------------------------------- ALONE: MC INTERNAL MONOLOGUE ----------------------------------------------------------------- */ <br><br> The silence inside the cabin is a living thing—heavy, suffocating, pressing in from every dark corner. You killed the radio hours ago when the stations stopped being stations and became something else. Something dark is piled against the main entrance. <br><br> To the <b>right</b>: an overgrown cul-de-sac winds into a dark suburban development. Prominent at the corner, a large two-story colonial home with its windows intact—every single one. In the mist, you can see one of the ground- floor windows has been covered from the inside with what appears to be a dark curtain or blanket. The front door is closed. The porch light is dead. <br><br> Two options. Very different silences. You need to decide. /* --- 4. Recent—within the last day or two based on the edge definition. Whoever arrived, they came alone, from the south. And the blanket over the window isn't thick enough. Booking desk up front, evidence locker center, secure armory in the rear. You adapt faster than anyone else. <br> <i style="color:#888;">You define your own survival.</i> </div> <div class="job-stats" style="border-left: 2px solid #fff;"> <span style="color:#fff">PERKS:</span> Fast Learner & Adrenaline<br> <span style="color:#fff">START:</span> Baseball Bat, Textbook </div> <<button "SELECT STUDENT">> <<set $job to "Student">> <<set $str to 2>><<set $int to 2>><<set $agi to 2>><<set $cha to 2>><<set $per to 2>> <<run window.setPerk("FAST LEARNER", "image/perks/fast_learner.png", "Gain XP 2x faster.")>> <<run window.setPerk("ADRENALINE", "image/perks/adrenaline.png", "Stats boost when HP below 30%.")>> <<run setup.addItem("Baseball Bat", 1)>><<run setup.addItem("Textbook", 1)>> <<goto "Student_Exercise">> <</button>> </div> </div> </div> <!-- END job-grid --> <</nobr>><<set $activeMap to "The Ascott Grand's Lobby">> <<nobr>> /* ========================================================================== 0. INITIALIZATION & SETUP Sets default variables the first time the player enters the lobby. ============================================================================= */ <<if ndef $lobby_phase>> <<set $currentLocation to "nw_room">> <<set $locationName to "NW Wing">> <<set $lobby_phase to 1>> <<set $vane_status to "alive">> <<set $maya_status to "alive">> <<set $backpack_looted to false>> <<set $vane_done to false>> <<set $maya_done to false>> <<set $loot_done to false>> <<if ndef $companions>> <<set $companions to[]>> <</if>> /* ── START AUDIO EXACTLY ONCE ── */ <<run if (typeof window.HallwayAmbience !== 'undefined') window.HallwayAmbience.stop()>> <<run setup.sound.play("lobby_slaughter", "audio/bgm/lobby_slaughter.mp3", true, 0.6)>> <</if>> /* ========================================================================== 1. WEAPON & COMBAT LOGIC SETUP Checks equipment and calculates stamina costs before rendering the UI. ============================================================================= */ /* ── WEAPON TYPE DETECTION ── */ <<set _isGun to (def setup.ammoMap[$equip.weapon])>> <<set _isBlade to ["Combat Knife","Hunting Knife","Kitchen Knife","Scalpel"].includes($equip.weapon)>> <<set _isBlunt to["Baseball Bat","Golf Club","Sledgehammer","Cane","Tire Iron","Crowbar"].includes($equip.weapon)>> <<set _isUnarmed to ($equip.weapon == "none")>> /* ── STAMINA DEDUCTION FOR MOVEMENT (GHOST BAR FIX) ── */ /* Runs ON LOAD so the animation system captures the old stat and animates downward */ <<if $didMove>> <<set $didMove to false>> /* Reduced movement cost: 2 for high Agility, 5 for low Agility */ <<set _moveCost to ($agi >= 5 ? 2 : 5)>> /* NEW EXERTION WIDGET */ <<exert _moveCost>> <<run window.animateStatBar('.bar-fill.stamina', $stamina, $stamina_max)>> <<run window.animateStatBar('.bar-fill.hp', $hp, $hp_max)>> /* Added HP update for Burn the Muscle */ <</if>> /* ── COMBAT CHECK ── */ /* Pre-calculates if the player will win their fight to keep the narrative code cleaner below */ <<set _combat_success to false>> <<if _isGun>> <<if $skills.shooting >= 1 or $per >= 4>> <<set _combat_success to true>> <</if>> <<elseif not _isUnarmed>> <<if $str >= 4 or $skills.melee >= 1>> <<set _combat_success to true>> <</if>> <<else>> <<if $str >= 6 or $skills.melee >= 2>> <<set _combat_success to true>> <</if>> <</if>> <</nobr>> /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ PHASE 1 — LOBBY HUB (ARRIVAL) The player first sees the lobby and is presented with 4 simultaneous crises. ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ <<if $lobby_phase == 1>> <h2>THE ASCOTT LOBBY — GROUND FLOOR</h2> <div style="margin-bottom:15px; text-align:center;"> <img src="C:\Users\Neal Sage\Documents\Twine\image\lobby\Lobby_Main.gif" style="max-width:100%; border:1px solid #333;"> </div> The stairwell door punches open and you stumble through it into the lobby. <br><br> The Ascott Grand's lobby was designed to make you feel small — fifty feet of vaulted ceiling, polished marble floors the color of old bone, chandeliers that cost more than most people earn in a decade. It was built for first impressions. Right now it is delivering one. <br><br> The smell hits first. Blood and gunpowder and something underneath both — something animal and wrong, the smell of a body that is still moving but should not be. Then the sound: screaming layered over screaming, the wet skid of shoe leather on marble, glass shattering somewhere above, and underneath all of it a low and continuous sound from things that should not still be making sounds. The lobby's grandeur is completely unequal to the situation. The chandeliers are still lit. That might be the most disturbing thing — all those warm amber bulbs still burning like nothing happened, throwing gold light across everything happening below. <br><br> You press your back against the stairwell door and take one full second to see it all clearly. One second. That is all you can afford. <br><br> Three crises. Right now. Unfolding simultaneously. And you are one person. <!-- GRID CONTAINER FOR CRISIS CARDS --> <div class="crisis-grid"> <!-- CRISIS 1: VANE / ELEVATORS --> <<if not $vane_done>> <div class="crisis-card"> <img src="C:\Users\Neal Sage\Documents\Twine\image\lobby\Femboy_in_need.gif"> <div class="crisis-text"> <b style="color:var(--accent-blue);">By the elevator banks</b> — an <span style="color:var(--accent-blue);">androgynous young man</span> is making his last stand against an infected with nothing but a heavy metal briefcase. He is losing ground with every step. </div> <div class="choice-menu"> <button> <<link "Sprint to Elevators">> <<set $didMove to true>> <<set $currentLocation to "e_room">> <<set $locationName to "Elevator Banks">> <<set $lobby_phase to "crossing_to_vane">> <<goto "Lobby_Entrance">> <</link>> <span class="btn-sub">Rush to help the young man.</span> </button> </div> </div> <</if>> <!-- CRISIS 2: MAYA / RECEPTION --> <<if not $maya_done>> <div class="crisis-card"> <img src="C:\Users\Neal Sage\Documents\Twine\image\lobby\Brown_woman_in_need.gif"> <div class="crisis-text"> <b style="color:var(--accent-blue);">At the reception desk</b> — a <span style="color:var(--accent-blue);">brown woman and her young daughter</span> are trapped in a shrinking circle behind the counter. The infected is pressing them back against the wall. She is out of space. </div> <div class="choice-menu"> <button> <<link "Sprint to Reception">> <<set $didMove to true>> <<set $currentLocation to "ne_room">> <<set $locationName to "Reception Desk">> <<set $lobby_phase to "crossing_to_maya">> <<goto "Lobby_Entrance">> <</link>> <span class="btn-sub">Rush to help the mother and child.</span> </button> </div> </div> <</if>> <!-- CRISIS 3: DEAD MAN / LOOT --> <<if not $loot_done>> <div class="crisis-card"> <img src="C:\Users\Neal Sage\Documents\Twine\image\lobby\Lobby_Dead_Man.gif"> <div class="crisis-text"> <b style="color:var(--accent-gold);">At your feet</b> — a dead man wearing a <span style="color:var(--accent-gold);">military-grade backpack</span> that looks completely untouched. Whatever killed him moved on fast. </div> <div class="choice-menu"> <button> <<link "Loot the Backpack">> <<set $didMove to true>> <<set $currentLocation to "n_room">> <<set $locationName to "North Lobby">> <<set $lobby_phase to "crossing_to_loot">> <<goto "Lobby_Entrance">> <</link>> <span class="btn-sub">Prioritize the supplies. Every second counts.</span> </button> </div> </div> <</if>> <!-- CRISIS 4: POLICE BARRICADE / FRONT DOORS --> <div class="crisis-card"> <img src="C:\Users\Neal Sage\Documents\Twine\image\lobby\Police_barricade.gif"> <div class="crisis-text"> <b style="color:var(--accent-gold);">At the glass front doors</b> — two police officers have constructed a barricade. Rifles up. They are twenty feet from people dying and they have not moved once. </div> <div class="choice-menu"> <button> <<link "Head to Front Doors">> <<set $didMove to true>> <<set $currentLocation to "lobby_exit">> <<set $locationName to "Front Barricade">> <<set $lobby_phase to "crossing_to_exit">> <<goto "Lobby_Entrance">> <</link>> <span class="btn-sub">Ignore the chaos and head straight for the exit.</span> </button> </div> </div> </div> /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ TRANSIT — CROSSING TO VANE Narrative filler before the Vane combat sequence. ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ <<elseif $lobby_phase == "crossing_to_vane">> <h2>LOBBY — CROSSING TO THE ELEVATORS</h2> You break left and run. <br><br> The marble is treacherous — your first step skids half an inch and your stomach drops, but you find your footing fast and open into a full sprint. The lobby feels enormous when you are trying to cross it in a hurry. Your footfalls crack loud against the stone. Things in the room turn toward the sound. You do not stop. <br><br> Fifteen feet. Ten. You can hear him now — ragged, panicked breathing, the metallic clang of the briefcase connecting with something, and underneath all of it that low vocalization of the infected: not a scream, not a growl, something in between that your brain keeps trying to categorize and cannot. A wet and continuous sound, like something that has forgotten what a mouth is for. <br><br> Five feet. You see his face properly for the first time. Young. Dyed hair plastered to his forehead with sweat. Eyes wide and very dark and still fighting even though every rational part of him has clearly given up on the outcome. He catches sight of you closing the distance and something shifts in his expression — not relief yet. Just a held breath. A very small, desperate adjustment from <i>this is it</i> to <i>maybe not yet</i>. <br><br> The infected does not see you. Its entire world has narrowed to the man in front of it. <br><br> <div class="choice-menu"> <button> <<link "Move in">> <<set $didMove to true>> <<set $lobby_phase to "rescue_vane">> <<goto "Lobby_Entrance">> <</link>> <span class="btn-sub">Engage the infected.</span> </button> </div> /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ RESCUE VANE — ELEVATOR (COMBAT RESOLUTION) ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ <<elseif $lobby_phase == "rescue_vane">> <h2>LOBBY — ELEVATOR RESCUE</h2> The young man's back connects with the elevator doors with a hollow metallic thud. He is out of room. The briefcase is too heavy to keep swinging one-handed and his arms are shaking at the joints. The creature is right there — jaws open, hands clawing, close enough that you can see the damage already done to it from here: half its face is wrong, the skin sitting wrong, the eyes filming over to white. It does not feel pain. That is the only advantage it has. It is enough. <br><br> <!-- ==== COMBAT SUCCESS BLOCK ==== --> <<if _combat_success>> <span style="color:var(--accent-green);">[COMBAT — SUCCESS]</span> <span style="color:var(--accent-gold);">[+25 XP]</span> <<if not $lobby_vane_xp>> <<run window.gainXP(25)>> <<set $lobby_vane_xp to true>> <</if>> <br><br> <<if _isGun>> You come in from the creature's left, angling hard for the shot that does not put him behind the exit point. Your <span style="color:var(--accent-blue);"><<print $equip.weapon>></span> is up before you have fully closed the distance. One round into the marble ceiling directly above its head — not to hurt it, to stop it. The crack of the shot in the enclosed space is enormous, a flat percussive slap that bounces off every hard surface in the lobby simultaneously. The creature flinches. Just a half-second of recoil, the ruined brain still responding to sudden overwhelming sound. You use that half-second completely. You close the remaining distance, press the barrel hard to its temple, and squeeze. The report is muffled by the contact. The creature drops straight down, taking his briefcase with it — the handle is caught in its hands on the way to the floor — and he stumbles forward, palms catching the elevator door frame, barely staying upright. <br><br> He stares at the thing on the floor. He stares at his own hands. He stares at you. <<elseif _isBlade>> You close the gap without slowing, coming in low and angled from the side where the creature has no peripheral vision left. Your <span style="color:var(--accent-blue);"><<print $equip.weapon>></span> finds the back of its neck before it registers you are there. It seizes — a full-body spasm, no vocalization, just that awful shuddering lock-up as the signals stop — and its legs buckle. It takes the blade down with it as it falls, weight and gravity pulling the handle out of your grip. You put your boot flat on its shoulder, brace, and wrench the weapon free with both hands. The marble goes dark around it in a spreading circle. He is pressed flat against the elevator doors, not breathing, both hands still raised in the defensive posture that no longer has anything to defend against. <br><br> For a moment, neither of you move. <<elseif _isBlunt>> You do not break stride. Your <span style="color:var(--accent-blue);"><<print $equip.weapon>></span> is back over your shoulder before you reach it — a full hitter's grip, both hands, full rotation. The impact when it connects is dense and terrible, a sound you feel traveling up through your hands and into your arms before you actually process hearing it, and the creature staggers sideways into the elevator door frame with enough force to dent the brushed metal. It is still moving. You bring it down again, harder, a shorter arc with more weight behind it. Then once more. Then it is not moving anymore and the lobby feels very quiet and your forearms are humming from the vibration. <br><br> You breathe. He is staring at you. <<else>> You hit it at a dead sprint — full body weight, both arms, everything — wrapping yourself around its midsection and driving it off from him and sideways into the wall. The impact is brutal on everyone's part. You hit the marble hard, the creature on top of you for one sickening second, its jaws snapping at air two inches from your face. You get your hands up on its throat before it can redirect and roll, take the top, pin it with your knees. It thrashes. It does not stop thrashing. You bring your elbow down on its skull — once, twice, three times, four — until your arm goes numb from the impacts and it finally stops moving and he is somewhere above you saying your name or something like your name, but the blood is loud in your ears and you cannot parse words yet. <br><br> You sit back on your heels. You look at your hands. <</if>> <<set $vane_status to "saved">> <<set $hum += 10>> <br><br> He slides slowly down the elevator doors until he is sitting on the floor. He does not say anything for a long moment. He is looking at the thing beside him. Then he looks at his own hands, still shaking at the wrists. Then he looks at you — really looks at you, the way people look at someone when they are updating an entire model of how the world works. <br><br> A long, controlled breath goes out of him — the deliberate kind, the kind you breathe when you are choosing to be calm rather than the alternative. <br><br> <span style="color:var(--accent-blue);">"I'm Vane,"</span> he says. His voice is steadier than his hands. <span style="color:var(--accent-blue);">"I know this is a genuinely terrible time for introductions. I just want to say that out loud. Also —"</span> He gestures vaguely at the creature on the floor. <span style="color:var(--accent-blue);">"— thank you. I was not winning that. At all. PLAYER DECISION: DESCENT METHOD --> <!-- ======================================================= --> <div style="margin-top:20px; padding:15px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border-left:3px solid var(--accent-blue);"> <b style="color:var(--accent-blue);">⚙️ HOW DO YOU DESCEND?</b><br><br> <<nobr>> /* ─── CHECK INVENTORY FOR DYNAMIC OPTIONS ─── */ <<set _hasFlashlight to $inventory.find(i => i.id === "Flashlight")>> <<set _hasLighter to $inventory.find(i => i.id === "Lighter")>> <</nobr>> <div class="choice-menu"> <!-- OPTION 1: QUICK DESCENT (Always Available) --> <button> <<link "🏃 Move Quickly (2 minutes)">> <<run setup.sound.play("boots_run", "audio/sfx/boots_run_concrete.mp3", false, 0.8)>> <<set $descentMethod to "quick">> <<addTime 1>> <<goto "Stairwell_Landing">> <</link>> <span class="btn-sub"><b style="color:var(--accent-gold);">[AGI CHECK]</b> Get down as fast as possible. You risk slipping in the dark.</span> </button> <!-- OPTION 2: SLOW DESCENT (Always Available) --> <button> <<link "🚶 Move Slowly and Carefully (10 minutes)">> <<run setup.sound.play("boots_slow", "audio/sfx/boots_slow_concrete.mp3", false, 0.6)>> <<set $descentMethod to "slow">> <<addTime 9>> <<goto "Stairwell_Landing">> <</link>> <span class="btn-sub"><b style="color:var(--accent-green);">[SAFE]</b> Take it step by step. Uses much more time, but guarantees you won't fall.</span> </button> <!-- OPTION 3: FLASHLIGHT DESCENT --> <<if _hasFlashlight>> <button> <<link "🔦 Use your Flashlight (4 minutes)">> <<run setup.sound.play("flashlight", "audio/sfx/flashlight_click.mp3", false, 0.8)>> <<set $descentMethod to "flashlight">> <<addTime 3>> <<goto "Stairwell_Landing">> <</link>> <span class="btn-sub"><b style="color:var(--accent-gold);">[GEAR]</b> Illuminates the path perfectly. Fast and safe.</span> </button> <</if>> <!-- OPTION 4: LIGHTER DESCENT --> <<if _hasLighter>> <button> <<link "🔥 Use your Lighter (6 minutes)">> <<run setup.sound.play("lighter", "audio/sfx/lighter_flick.mp3", false, 0.8)>> <<set $descentMethod to "lighter">> <<addTime 5>> <<goto "Stairwell_Landing">> <</link>> <span class="btn-sub"><b style="color:var(--accent-gold);">[GEAR]</b> A flickering flame. Better than nothing, but forces you to move somewhat slowly.</span> </button> <</if>> <!-- FALLBACK: NO LIGHT SOURCE (Diegetic Hint) --> <<if not _hasFlashlight and not _hasLighter>> <button disabled style="opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; border-color: #333;"> <span style="text-decoration: line-through;">💡 Illuminate the stairwell</span><br> <span class="btn-sub" style="color: #666;">[REQUIRES LIGHT SOURCE] It's too dark to see the steps clearly. You don't have a flashlight or a lighter to cut through the gloom.</span> </button> <</if>> </div> <!-- End of Choice Menu --> </div> <!-- End of Interaction Box -->/* ================================================================= 1. INITIALIZATION & SETUP Swap UI map to 2nd Floor, update location pin, and check if the player experienced the horrors on the 4th floor. ================================================================= */ <<set $activeMap to "Stairwell 2F">> <<set $currentLocation to "F2 Entrance">> /* FIXED: Added $room406_opened to the horrors check */ <<set _sawHorrors to (visited("Unit_401") or $room402_opened or $room405_opened or $room406_opened)>> /* ================================================================= 2. DESCENT RESOLUTION Narrative and stat outcomes based on how they entered the stairs. ================================================================= */ <<if $descentMethod == "quick">> You take the stairs two at a time, desperate to put distance between yourself and the 4th floor. Your footsteps echo sharply against the concrete walls. Your momentum is carrying you fast—maybe too fast. /* --- AGILITY CHECK (Attributes scaled 1-10) --- */ <<if $agi >= 5>> <br><br> <span style="color:var(--accent-green);">[AGILITY SUCCESS]</span> In the flickering strobe light, your boot hovers over a slick, dark patch on the stairs. Your reflexes take over. With a surge of adrenaline, you blindly grab the heavy iron handrail, wrenching your shoulder but stopping your fall. You vault over the slick step, landing heavily on the landing below. <<else>> /* Audio: Play violent tumble sound on AGI fail */ <<run setup.sound.play("tumble", "audio/sfx/stairs_tumble.mp3", false, 1.0)>> <br><br> <span style="color:var(--accent-red);">[AGILITY FAILED]</span> In the strobe-lit darkness, you never see the wet, slick patch coating the steps. <br><br> Your heel slides out from under you. The world tilts sickeningly. You violently tumble forward, concrete biting into your ribs and knees. You slam into the metal railing and skid to a halt on the landing below, your lungs burning and your shoulder screaming in pain. <span style="color:var(--accent-red); font-weight:bold;">-15 HP + HEAVILY DRAINS YOUR STAMINA</span> <<set $hp -= 15>> <<exert 20>> /* Animate UI bars downward */ <<run window.animateStatBar('.bar-fill.hp', $hp, $hp_max)>> <<run window.animateStatBar('.bar-fill.stamina', $stamina, $stamina_max)>> <<run window.shakeScreen(30)>> <</if>> <<elseif $descentMethod == "slow">> You grip the cold iron handrail, taking it one agonizing step at a time. The emergency strobes paint the stairwell in flashes of harsh crimson and pitch black. <br><br> As the light flares, the concrete step below you glistens. Something thick and wet is pooling there, dripping slowly over the edge. You press your back against the wall and carefully step wide, avoiding the slick patch entirely. <<elseif $descentMethod == "flashlight">> You flick on your flashlight. Its stark white beam cuts through the oppressive, pulsing red of the emergency lights. <br><br> The beam sweeps down the concrete stairs and catches a dark reflection. A thick, wet puddle coats the middle of the flight, trailing down the edges like dark syrup. Keeping the beam steady, you safely navigate around the mess. <<elseif $descentMethod == "lighter">> You flick your lighter. The small, trembling orange flame fights against the oppressive, pulsing red of the emergency strobes, casting wild, dancing shadows against the concrete walls. <br><br> Holding the flame low, you catch the glint of something wet. A thick puddle coats the middle of the flight, trailing down the steps. It's hard to see the edges in the flickering light, but you manage to carefully step around the worst of it. <</if>> <br><br> /* ================================================================= 3. NARRATIVE REACTION TO THE BLOOD Only plays if the player didn't fall down during a 'quick' descent. ================================================================= */ <<if $descentMethod == "slow" or $descentMethod == "flashlight" or $descentMethod == "lighter">> /* Audio: Play slow, dripping blood loop while observing */ <<run setup.sound.play("blood_drip", "audio/sfx/blood_drip.mp3", true, 0.6)>> You reach the landing and look back up at what you almost stepped in. <br><br> It's blood. Arterial, dark, and fresh enough to still be shining. <br><br> <<if _sawHorrors>> /* Desensitized reaction */ After the carnage you left behind in the apartments upstairs, the sight barely registers. The shock has already burned out of your system. You just wipe a stray drop from your shoe and keep moving. <br> <<chat "You" "image/avatars/player.gif" "left" "Just more blood. Nothing I haven't seen already today.">> <<else>> /* Shocked reaction */ Your stomach drops. Until now, the nightmare was just a voice on the radio and a text message. But this is real. You feel a sudden, cold spike of dread in your chest. <br> <<chat "You" "image/avatars/player.gif" "left" "Someone was dragged down these stairs. Recently.">> <<set $hum -= 5>> /* FIXED: Added UI Ghost Bar animation for Humanity */ <<run window.animateStatBar('.bar-fill.humanity', $hum, 100)>> <br> <span style="color:var(--accent-red); font-size:0.85em;">-5 HUMANITY</span> <</if>> <</if>> <hr style="border-color:#333; margin: 20px 0;"> /* ================================================================= 4. THE BARRICADE (STORY PROGRESSION) Forces the player to detour through the 2nd Floor. ================================================================= */ <<set $currentLocation to "F1 Landing">> You continue your descent, hoping to push straight through to the ground floor lobby. But halfway between the 2nd and 1st floors, the stairs simply end. <br><br> <b style="color:var(--accent-gold);">The way down is completely blocked.</b> <br><br> Someone dragged heavy oak desks, folding chairs, and a massive glass-front vending machine into the stairwell, wedging them together into an impassable wall of junk. <br><br> There are no bodies here. No blood. Just a desperate, silent testament to whatever the residents were trying to keep from coming up the stairs. And by the look of the dented, buckling metal on the front of the vending machine... <br> <<chat "You" "image/avatars/player.gif" "left" "Whatever was trying to get up was strong. I can't get to the lobby this way.">> <br> You have to open the fire door to the 2nd Floor, cross the building, and find the East Wing stairwell. <<addObjective "detour_2f" "Cross the 2nd Floor to find the East Wing stairs">> /* Spawns new task */ <div style="margin-top:30px; text-align:center;"> <<button "Open the door to the 2nd Floor">> /* Audio Cleanup: Stop ambient triggers before switching to hallway */ <<if setup.sound.tracks["blood_drip"]>> <<run setup.sound.stop("blood_drip")>> <</if>> <<if setup.sound.tracks["generator_hum"]>> <<run setup.sound.fade("generator_hum", 2000)>> <</if>> <<run setup.sound.play("firedoor_click", "audio/sfx/firedoor_click.mp3", false, 0.7)>> /* --- OBJECTIVE MILESTONE LOGIC --- */ <<purgeCompleted>> /* Sweeps the completed escape task off the screen instantly */ /* Transition Setup */ <<addTime 2>> <<set $floorLevel to 2>> <<goto "Floor2_Hallway">> <</button>> </div><<nobr>> /* The air is dense with stale beer, cheap cologne, and something underneath both that you decide not to identify. <br><br> You follow the hallway to the living room. That's where you find him. <br><br> A massive oak entertainment center has toppled forward, catching a young man across the chest and pinning him flat to the floor. Twenty-something. Blond hair gone dark at the temples with sweat. His chest is not moving. <br><br> His right arm is outstretched. His fingers — already beginning to stiffen — are still loosely curled around a set of car keys. <br><br> The entertainment center is solid oak. At least three hundred pounds. The fall must have been instant.
